title: Ordinary section localization over an ambient affine open
statement: Let $X$ be a scheme [def-pc-scheme], $L$ an invertible module [def-sc-invertible-module], $F$ a quasi-coherent module [pqf-def-coherent], and $s\in\Gamma(X,L)$. Let $S$ be open with underlying set the nonvanishing locus of $s$ [def-weil-pbc-ample-invertible-module], and let $U$ be affine open. There is an additive equivalence $e:Q^\Gamma(U)\simeq\Gamma(U\cap S,F)$ [def-sc-open-section-fraction-presentation] such that $s^n e([n,t])=t|_{U\cap S}$ for every $n\geq0$ and $t\in\Gamma(U,F\otimes L^{\otimes n})$. Multiplication is the section map of the inverse right unitor followed by tensorPowSection.

source.place: Tags 01PW (2), equation module-invert-s, and 09MR, affine-open paragraph

proof.text: Restrict L, F and s to Y = U.toScheme. Restriction agrees with pullback, hence preserves invertibility and quasi-coherence. Restriction of sections and tensor powers identifies all numerator groups and their transition maps.

Apply affine_section_localization on Y. The stalk criterion identifies its nonvanishing open with the preimage of S, whose image is U cap S. The additive closure of fraction generators equals the additive subgroup of their module span: each scalar multiple of a generator is the generator of the scalar multiple numerator. Thus the numerator comparison descends to the additive fraction quotients.

Compose the quotient comparison and the section localization equivalence with restrictAppIso on the target. Naturality of restriction and the definition of tmulSection transport the fraction formula to the displayed coefficient-map identity. Empty U and zero s require no extra hypotheses.

lean.statement: theorem affineOpen_sectionFraction_localization (X : Scheme.{u}) (L : X.Modules) [L.IsInvertible] (s : Γ(L, ⊤)) (F : X.Modules) [F.IsQuasicoherent] (S : X.Opens) (hS : (S : Set X) = nonvanishingLocus L s) (U : X.Opens) (hU : IsAffineOpen U) : ∃ e : OpenSectionFractionPresentation L F s U ≃+ Γ(F, U ⊓ S), ∀ (n : ℕ) (t : Γ(F ⊗ L.tensorPow n, U)), (((ρ_ F).inv ≫ F ◁ tensorPowSection (homOfGlobalSection L s) n) : F ⟶ (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n : X.Modules)).app (U ⊓ S) (e (openSectionFraction L F s U n t)) = (F ⊗ L.tensorPow n).presheaf.map (homOfLE (inf_le_left : U ⊓ S ≤ U)).op t
